links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level, reading ease) of chatbot responses to flatfoot questions
links.effect: Gemini FK grade 9.2 ± 1.1 vs ChatGPT 11.8 ± 1.4 (P<.001); reading ease 59.4 ± 6.2 vs 42.5 ± 5.3 (P<.001). Both above typical patient-level reading grade.
links.quote: Gemini also generated longer responses (165 ± 20 vs 120 ± 15 words, P < .001) and showed better readability, with lower Flesch-Kincaid grade level (9.2 ± 1.1 vs 11.8 ± 1.4, P < .001) and higher Flesch reading ease score (59.4 ± 6.2 vs 42.5 ± 5.3, P < .001).

screen.reason: Compares ChatGPT and Google Gemini on factual accuracy, omissions, and readability for standardized patient flatfoot questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
